cities.name: Athens

interests.name: Ancient History 🏛️
interests.description: Athens is the birthplace of Western civilization, packed with ancient temples, theatres, and archaeological wonders. The Acropolis stands as the city’s crown jewel, offering a glimpse into classical Greece. Everywhere you walk, history surrounds you — from hidden ruins to world-famous landmarks.

interests.name: Sea Views 🌊
interests.description: Athens may be a historic capital, but it's also deeply connected to the sea. The coastline around Piraeus and the Athens Riviera offers stunning blue-water views and breezy promenades. Perfect for relaxing walks, seaside dining, or escaping the busy city center.

interests.name: Local Food 😋
interests.description: Greek cuisine in Athens is fresh, flavorful, and deeply rooted in Mediterranean tradition. From warm pies and roasted vegetables to sweet pastries and fragrant herbs, every dish feels homemade. Local tavernas in Plaka and beyond deliver authentic flavors you'll remember.

interests.name: Street Art 🎨
interests.description: Athens has one of Europe’s most vibrant street art scenes, especially in neighborhoods like Exarchia and Psiri. Murals cover entire buildings, turning the city into an open-air gallery. It’s a creative mix of political expression, urban storytelling, and local identity.

interests.name: Nightlife 🍸
interests.description: The city comes alive at night with rooftop terraces, cozy wine bars, and energetic music spots. Psiri and Gazi are nightlife hubs offering everything from quiet cocktails to late-night dancing. Whether you want elegance or chaos, Athens has a place for every mood.

cities.local_food_tip: Try spanakopita, gemista (stuffed vegetables), briam (baked vegetables), koulouri and loukoumades. Mediterranean flavors done right.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Start at the legendary Acropolis — Parthenon, Erekhtheion and panoramic views of Athens. → Continue to the modern Acropolis Museum. → ☕ Coffee break in Plaka. Afternoon: 🏺 Explore Ancient Agora and the Temple of Hephaestus. → 🍽️ Lunch in a seaside taverna in Piraeus: Piraeus Beachfront Tavernas. → 🛍️ Wander the historic Monastiraki Market. Late Afternoon: 🌆 Head up Lycabettus Hill by foot or funicular for golden-hour views. → Explore stylish Kolonaki. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the sky turn gold in Anafiotika, the Cycladic-style village under the Acropolis. Night: 🍸 Evening in Psiri: bars, music and vibrant nightlife. → Optional: Rooftop cocktails with Acropolis views.

ideas: 🌸 Walk through the National Garden.
🚶 Explore the Acropolis in pleasant weather.
🌅 Rooftop sunset views of the Acropolis.
🎬 Outdoor film night at Thision Cinema.
🌊 Dinner in Piraeus by the sea.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚇 Metro is the fastest way to get around Athens.
🚌 Buses & trolleybuses cover all major districts.
🚊 Tram connects the city center with the coast.
📱 Use the official transport app 'OASA Telematics' for live arrivals.
🚕 Taxis are widely available; apps like Beat work well.

city_events.name: Athens Epidaurus Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Performances and concerts across Athens and Epidaurus.

cities.name: Corfu

interests.name: Green Island Landscapes 🌿
interests.description: Corfu is one of Greece’s greenest islands, full of cypress trees, olive groves, and rolling hills. Its landscapes feel refreshing compared to the drier Cyclades. Perfect for scenic hikes, nature photography, and peaceful coastal walks.

interests.name: Old Town Streets 🏛️
interests.description: Corfu Old Town is a UNESCO World Heritage site filled with Venetian charm. Narrow alleys, tall pastel buildings, and hidden squares make it feel magical. It’s the ideal place to get lost, explore, shop, or enjoy a relaxed coffee.

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Corfu offers some of the most beautiful beaches in the Ionian Sea, with crystal-clear waters and dramatic cliffs. From sandy family-friendly spots to secluded coves, the island has something for every traveler. Perfect for swimming, snorkeling, or relaxing by the sea.

interests.name: Local Food 😋
interests.description: Corfiot cuisine blends Greek tradition with Venetian influences. Expect hearty pastas, local herbs, and kumquat-based desserts. Island tavernas serve warm, comforting meals with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors.

interests.name: Coastal Views 🌅
interests.description: Corfu’s coastline is full of breathtaking viewpoints and dramatic cliffsides overlooking turquoise waters. Sunset spots like Paleokastritsa offer unforgettable panoramas. A must-see for photographers and travelers who love scenic landscapes.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Corfiot-style vegetarian pastitsada, kumquat sweets, olive-based dishes, feta and freshly baked village bread.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Start exploring Corfu Old Town, a UNESCO site filled with Venetian architecture, narrow alleys and impressive fortresses. → ☕ Enjoy a relaxed morning coffee at Liston Square. Afternoon: 🌊 Head to one of Corfu’s stunning beaches: Glyfada Beach or Paleokastritsa Beach. → 🍽️ Lunch in a beachfront taverna: Paleokastritsa Seaside Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Enjoy incredible views from the Paleokastritsa Viewpoint. Night: 🌃 Return to the Old Town for an atmospheric evening walk through lantern-lit alleys and waterfront cafés.

ideas: 🌿 Explore lush hill paths around Paleokastritsa.
🚶 Relaxed Old Town strolls in mild weather.
🏖️ Crystal-clear swimming at Glyfada or Paleokastritsa.
🍉 Fresh fruit snacks by the beach.
🍽️ Cozy dinners in Old Town taverns.
🏛️ Explore Old Town museums and fortresses.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Use the official Green Buses (KTEL Corfu) for routes across the island.
🚍 Local blue buses operate within Corfu Town and nearby districts.
🚕 Taxis are available throughout the island; call or use local taxi apps.
🚗 Renting a car is recommended for beach hopping and exploring remote spots.
🚶 Corfu Old Town is fully walkable and perfect for strolling.

cities.name: Crete

interests.name: Mountains & Sea 🌄🌊
interests.description: Crete blends rugged mountains with crystal-blue seas, creating dramatic landscapes found nowhere else in Greece. The island is full of scenic drives, coastal hikes, and panoramic viewpoints. Nature lovers will find endless opportunities for exploration and photography.

interests.name: Beaches 🏖️
interests.description: Crete is home to some of Europe’s most famous beaches, including the pink sands of Elafonissi and the turquoise waters of Balos. Many beaches are surrounded by untouched nature and shallow, warm waters. Ideal for relaxing, swimming, or taking stunning holiday photos.

interests.name: Historic Sites 🏺
interests.description: As the center of the ancient Minoan civilization, Crete is filled with archaeological wonders. The Palace of Knossos stands as the island’s most iconic historic site, rich in myth and legend. Museums and ruins across the island reveal thousands of years of cultural heritage.

interests.name: Villages 🌿
interests.description: Traditional Cretan villages offer a slower, more authentic side of island life. Stone houses, narrow lanes, and warm hospitality define these local communities. They’re perfect for trying homemade food, exploring local shops, and enjoying mountain or seaside views.

interests.name: Local Food 😋
interests.description: Cretan cuisine is simple, fresh, and incredibly flavorful. Expect dishes made with local olive oil, wild herbs, honey, cheeses, and garden-grown vegetables. Village tavernas offer meals that feel homemade, often paired with raki or local wine.

cities.local_food_tip: Try dakos, Cretan salads, honey with yogurt, roasted vegetables, local cheeses, olives and freshly baked bread.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏺 Explore the legendary Knossos Palace — home of Minoan myths and ancient history. → ☕ Enjoy coffee in central Heraklion. Afternoon: 🌊 Visit one of Crete’s world-famous beaches: Elafonissi or Balos Lagoon. → 🍽️ Lunch in a beachfront taverna: Chania Seaside Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Experience a breathtaking sunset at the Old Venetian Port of Chania. Night: 🌃 Evening stroll along the waterfront with cafés, lights, and peaceful sea views.

ideas: 🌸 Mountain hikes with colorful spring flowers.
🌅 Long swimming season with warm seas.
🚶 Scenic nature walks with soft light.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 KTEL buses connect all major towns such as Heraklion, Chania, Rethymno, and Agios Nikolaos.
🚍 Local buses operate within larger cities like Heraklion and Chania.
🚗 Renting a car is recommended for beaches and villages in remote areas.
🚕 Taxis are widely available in major towns.

cities.name: Halkidiki (Kassandra Peninsula)

interests.name: Turquoise Beaches 🏖️
interests.description: Kassandra is known for some of the clearest, turquoise waters in northern Greece. Beaches are long, sandy, and perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Many have beach bars, calm coves, and shallow water ideal for families.

interests.name: Resort Vibes 😎
interests.description: The peninsula is full of modern resorts, lively beach clubs, and stylish seaside cafés. Travelers looking for relaxation will love the comfortable atmosphere and excellent service. It's an ideal area for a laid-back, sunny holiday.

interests.name: Nature 🌿
interests.description: Despite its popularity, Kassandra still offers beautiful stretches of nature. Pine forests meet the sea, creating scenic walking paths and coastline viewpoints. Afitos village, set on a cliff, offers some of the best natural views in the region.

interests.name: Local Tavernas 🍽️
interests.description: Halkidiki’s tavernas serve fresh Greek dishes with local ingredients, especially vegetables, cheese and Mediterranean herbs. Seaside restaurants offer relaxing dining with beautiful sunset views. It’s the perfect place to slow down and enjoy authentic food.

interests.name: Small Villages 🏡
interests.description: Kassandra’s villages each have their own charm, blending traditional Greek culture with modern coastal life. Stone-built Afitos stands out as one of the prettiest settlements. Wandering through these villages offers a great mix of culture, cafés, and scenic corners.

cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy moussaka, grilled vegetables, baked feta, fresh salads and warm bread with olive oil.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏖️ Begin at Kallithea Beach, famous for its turquoise waters and smooth sandy shoreline. → ☕ Enjoy coffee in a beachfront bar. Afternoon: 🌊 Visit Hanioti Beach or Pefkohori Beach. → 🍽️ Lunch in a beachfront taverna: Afitos Seaside Tavernas. Late Afternoon: 🚤 Optional boat ride along the coastline. → Explore the charming Afitos Village. Sunset: 🌇 Watch the golden sunset from Afitos cliffside. Night: 🎉 Evening drinks or light nightlife in Kallithea.

ideas: 🍸 Beach bars with music and cocktails.
🌊 Dramatic coastline views with winter waves.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 KTEL buses run from Thessaloniki to major villages in Kassandra.
🚗 Renting a car is the best way to explore beaches and coastal routes.
🚕 Taxis are available in main tourist villages.
🚶 Village centers and beaches are walkable once you arrive.

cities.name: Mykonos

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Mykonos is home to some of the most iconic beaches in Greece, known for crystal-clear water and golden sand. Many beaches offer great facilities, from quiet family areas to lively party zones. Whether you're relaxing or dancing by the sea, there's a beach for every mood.

interests.name: Nightlife 🎉
interests.description: The island is famous for its world-class nightlife, attracting DJs, artists, and travelers from all over the world. Clubs begin filling up at sunset and stay open until dawn. From beach parties to elegant cocktail lounges, Mykonos guarantees unforgettable nights.

interests.name: Windmills 🌬️
interests.description: The famous windmills are one of Mykonos’ most iconic landmarks. Overlooking the Aegean Sea, they offer perfect photo spots, especially during sunset. Their history dates back centuries, making them a fascinating blend of heritage and scenery.

interests.name: Chic Streets 🏛️
interests.description: Mykonos Town (Chora) is a maze of whitewashed alleyways, stylish boutiques, and charming cafés. The architecture is traditionally Cycladic, giving the town a bright, picturesque feel. It’s the perfect place for wandering, shopping, and discovering hidden corners.

interests.name: Local Food 🍽️
interests.description: Mykonos offers delicious Cycladic specialties made with fresh vegetables, cheeses, and herbs. From onion pies to honey desserts, the island’s flavors reflect its rich culinary culture. Local tavernas provide authentic meals with stunning sea views.

cities.local_food_tip: Try Mykonian onion pie, local cheeses, fresh salads, honey pastries and Cycladic desserts.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏙️ Begin in Mykonos Town (Chora) and wander through the photogenic white alleys. → 🌬️ Visit the famous Windmills overlooking the sea. → ☕ Coffee in Little Venice. Afternoon: 🏖️ Head to the island’s beaches: Ornos, Platis Gialos or Paradise Beach. → 🍽️ Lunch by the sea in Platis Gialos Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Return to Little Venice for colorful sunset views. Night: 🎉 Enjoy Mykonos’ famous nightlife: beach clubs, dance floors and stylish cocktail bars.

ideas: 🚶 Quiet walks in Chora with fewer crowds.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Mykonos buses connect major beaches with Chora.
🚕 Taxis are limited — expect waiting times during high season.
🚤 Water taxis connect beaches along the southern coast.
🚗 Renting a car or ATV is common for exploring the island.

cities.name: Rhodes

interests.name: Medieval Old Town 🏰
interests.description: Rhodes Old Town is one of the best-preserved medieval cities in Europe. Its walls, gates and cobblestone lanes feel like stepping back in time. Visitors can explore fortresses, museums and atmospheric old streets full of history.

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Rhodes offers a mix of sandy beaches, calm bays, and crystal-clear water. Popular spots like Elli Beach provide excellent swimming conditions. Many beaches have cafés, sunbeds and beautiful views of the Aegean Sea.

interests.name: Sunshine 🌞
interests.description: Rhodes is known for having some of the sunniest weather in all of Greece. Long, warm days make it ideal for outdoor activities and beach time. The island’s clear skies create perfect conditions for sunsets and golden-hour photography.

interests.name: Local Food 🍽️
interests.description: Rhodes offers delicious Greek cuisine, from roasted vegetables to cheese pies and freshly baked breads. Tavernas across the island serve authentic dishes made with local ingredients. Visitors can enjoy seaside meals, cozy village dinners, or street snacks in Old Town.

interests.name: Ancient & Medieval Sites 🏺
interests.description: Beyond its medieval walls, Rhodes also features ancient Greek ruins. The Rhodes Acropolis offers panoramic views and fascinating archaeological remains. It’s a must-see spot for travelers who enjoy blending history with scenic landscapes.

cities.local_food_tip: Try gyros, roasted vegetables, oven-baked feta, local pies and honey-based desserts.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Explore the iconic Rhodes Old Town, including medieval walls and the Palace of the Grand Master. → ☕ Coffee in the old stone-paved lanes. Afternoon: 🌊 Swim and relax at Elli Beach. → 🍽️ Lunch by the seaside: Elli Beach Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Head to the Rhodes Acropolis for an unforgettable sunset. Night: 🌃 Enjoy a relaxing walk or light nightlife in Old Town’s cozy bars and lantern-lit squares.

ideas: 🏖️ Full-day beach time at Elli Beach.
🍦 Ice cream strolls in Old Town.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 The island’s KTEL buses connect Rhodes Town with major beaches and villages.
🚍 Local buses operate frequently around Rhodes Town.
🚕 Taxis are common and can be found near major tourist zones.
🚗 Renting a car is recommended for exploring the island comfortably.

cities.name: Santorini

interests.name: Caldera Views 🌋
interests.description: Santorini’s caldera is one of the most dramatic landscapes in the world. Towering cliffs drop into deep-blue volcanic waters, creating unforgettable panoramas. The views change throughout the day, offering new colors and moods from sunrise to sunset.

interests.name: Sunsets 🌇
interests.description: The island is globally famous for its sunsets, especially from Oia and Imerovigli. As the sun dips into the Aegean, the sky turns golden, pink and purple. Travelers gather early to secure the best viewpoint — it’s truly a magical moment.

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Santorini features unique volcanic beaches with red, black and golden sand. Places like Red Beach and Kamari offer striking scenery and refreshing swimming spots. These beaches are perfect for relaxing, sunbathing, and exploring unusual coastlines.

interests.name: Cycladic Atmosphere 🏛️
interests.description: Whitewashed houses, blue domes and narrow alleys define Santorini’s traditional Cycladic charm. Villages like Fira and Oia feel like open-air postcards. It’s a dreamy environment that blends history, art and island lifestyle.

interests.name: Food & Wine 🍷
interests.description: Santorini’s cuisine is fresh and filled with Mediterranean flavors. Local dishes like tomato fritters and fava pair perfectly with the island’s famous Assyrtiko wine. Wineries across the island offer tastings with breathtaking volcanic views.

cities.local_food_tip: Try fava, tomato fritters, saganaki, Greek salads, and the island-famous Assyrtiko wines.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌅 Begin in Fira for breathtaking caldera views and Cycladic alleys. → Walk through Firostefani toward Imerovigli. → ☕ Coffee overlooking the volcano. Afternoon: 🌋 Explore Oia, home to boutiques, galleries and stunning viewpoints. → 🍽️ Lunch on the cliff: Oia Cliffside Tavernas. → 🌊 Relax at Red Beach or Kamari Beach. Late Afternoon: 🚤 Optional caldera cruise — perfect for photography and relaxing. Sunset: 🌇 Watch Santorini’s legendary sunset from the Oia Castle Viewpoint. Night: 🌃 Return to Fira for dessert and rooftop wine bars with night views.

ideas: 🌸 Scenic walks from Imerovigli to Oia.
🌊 Early morning hikes to avoid crowds.
🍦 Ice cream breaks along the caldera.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Island buses connect all major towns including Fira, Oia, Kamari and Perissa.
🚕 Taxis are available but limited — expect waiting times in peak season.
🚗 Renting a car or ATV is the easiest way to explore the island.
🚶 Cliff paths between Fira and Oia are walkable and incredibly scenic.

city_events.name: Santorini Volcano Celebration
city_events.description: 🌋 Fireworks and cultural events honoring the island’s volcanic heritage.

cities.name: Stavros (Halkidiki)

interests.name: Sandy Beaches 🏖️
interests.description: Stavros offers long sandy beaches with clear and calm waters, perfect for swimming or relaxing. The coastline is peaceful compared to larger resorts. It’s an ideal destination for travelers seeking a quiet and comforting seaside experience.

interests.name: Relaxed Town Atmosphere 😎
interests.description: The town has a laid-back charm with local cafés, bakeries and friendly residents. Streets are walkable and easy to explore. It’s the kind of place where you slow down, enjoy the moment, and feel the calm of a small Greek seaside town.

interests.name: Nature Trails 🌿
interests.description: Stavros is surrounded by forested hills and scenic walking paths. The trails offer a refreshing mix of sea views and shaded greenery. Great for short hikes, photography, or simply escaping into nature.

interests.name: Local Tavernas 🍽️
interests.description: Tavernas in Stavros serve delicious Greek dishes made with fresh vegetables, olive oil, herbs and simple Mediterranean flavors. Most are family-run, offering a warm and authentic dining experience. Many spots have outdoor seating near the water.

interests.name: Seaside Walks 🌊
interests.description: The town’s quiet seafront walkway is perfect for morning coffee or evening strolls. Soft waves, open skies and coastal breezes create a peaceful atmosphere. It’s one of the best places in Stavros to unwind and enjoy the scenery.

cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy souvlaki, roasted vegetables, fresh bread, Greek salads and yogurt-based desserts.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏖️ Start your day at Stavros Beach, a calm sandy shoreline perfect for swimming and relaxation. → ☕ Seafront coffee on the promenade. Afternoon: 🌿 Explore scenic forest trails above the town with sea views: Stavros Nature Trails. → 🍽️ Lunch in a beachfront taverna: Stavros Seaside Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Enjoy a quiet sunset directly from the beach. Night: 🌃 Evening walk along the peaceful seaside promenade with cafés and soft lights.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Regional buses connect Stavros with Thessaloniki and nearby towns.
🚗 Renting a car offers flexibility for exploring beaches and villages.
🚕 Local taxis operate within the town and nearby areas.
🚶 The town itself is fully walkable.

cities.name: Zakynthos

interests.name: Blue Caves 🌊
interests.description: The Blue Caves are one of Zakynthos’ most famous natural wonders, filled with glowing turquoise water. Sunlight reflects off the limestone walls, creating a magical blue illumination. Boat trips allow visitors to explore the caves up close and capture unforgettable photos.

interests.name: Navagio (Shipwreck) Bay 🏖️
interests.description: Navagio Bay is one of the most photographed beaches in the world. Its white sand, towering cliffs and shipwreck create a dramatic, iconic landscape. The viewpoint offers breathtaking panoramas that look straight out of a postcard.

interests.name: Sea Views 🌅
interests.description: Zakynthos is filled with spectacular sea viewpoints, from high cliffs to gentle coastal hills. Sunset spots like Keri Lighthouse are especially stunning. The island’s dramatic coastline makes it perfect for photography lovers.

interests.name: Island Food 🍽️
interests.description: Zakynthos offers fresh, flavorful dishes inspired by Greek and local Ionian culinary traditions. Expect rich pastas, local cheeses, potato pies and honey-based desserts. Tavernas across the island provide authentic home-style meals with warm Greek hospitality.

interests.name: Coastal Villages 🏡
interests.description: Small coastal villages on Zakynthos offer peaceful scenery and traditional Greek charm. Many feature friendly tavernas, calm beaches and relaxing promenades. They’re ideal for unwinding, exploring local culture and enjoying seaside views.

cities.local_food_tip: Try vegetarian pastitsada, potato pies, fresh salads, local cheeses, and honey-based island desserts.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏖️ Begin with a visit to the world-famous Navagio (Shipwreck) Bay Viewpoint — one of Greece’s most iconic sights. → ☕ Enjoy a scenic coffee overlooking the cliffs. Afternoon: 🌊 Take a boat trip to the stunning Blue Caves (no swimming required). → 🍽️ Lunch at a beachfront taverna: Alykes Beach Tavernas. Sunset: 🌇 Head to the dramatic Keri Lighthouse Viewpoint for panoramic sunset views. Night: 🌃 Take a relaxed evening walk around Zakynthos Town with seaside cafés and peaceful streets.

ideas: 🌊 Quiet early-season Blue Caves boat tours.
🌸 Mild island weather perfect for exploring.
🏖️ Navagio Bay viewpoints at their brightest.
🚤 Boat trips to Blue Caves and coastal coves.
🥗 Light seaside lunches with fresh ingredients.
🍁 Fewer crowds at beaches and viewpoints.
🍽️ Cozy tavern dinners in coastal villages.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Local KTEL buses connect Zakynthos Town with major beaches and villages.
🚗 Renting a car is highly recommended for reaching viewpoints and remote beaches.
🚕 Taxis operate throughout the island and can be booked via phone or local taxi stations.
🚤 Many boat tours depart from northern harbors like Agios Nikolaos.
